evals.prompt: The user asks for a 1960s historical narrative from an archive export with manifest rows, OCR text, and source cards.
evals.expected_output: Builds asset, search, claim, claim-treatment, window-summary, and narrative-review artifacts before writing a decade narrative, and ties claims to source anchors.
assertions: Source assets are inventoried with stable IDs, hashes, date evidence, access status, and derived OCR/index artifacts.
Claims remain atomic and point to source anchors before any broad narrative is written.
A critical-historian review checks source coverage, OCR stability, claim treatment, and publication constraints before rollup.

evals.prompt: The user provides an existing narrative and asks whether new documents change the interpretation.
evals.expected_output: Searches for support and counterevidence, updates a Shepard-style treatment ledger, and marks claims as supported, qualified, contradicted, superseded, distinguished, duplicated, or needing review.
assertions: The agent does not overwrite old claims without recording treatment history.
Contradictory and qualifying evidence is recorded separately from direct support.
Rollup or rewrite recommendations cite claim-treatment rows and residual uncertainty.

evals.prompt: The user asks to test the skill against the Sunshine vault without changing source files.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Sunshine manifest as a read-only seed, treats content_sha256 as durable identity, writes a local evidence bundle, validates it, and leaves vault files untouched.
assertions: The Sunshine manifest is read without moving, deleting, or rewriting vault files.
The generated bundle includes asset, search, claim, treatment, summary, and review artifacts.
The next enrichment steps call for OCR/page spans, semantic or hybrid search, source-card checks, and public-access review.
